hook: Democrats flipped Texas. And 6 more seats
reel_hook: Democrats flipped Texas. Here's what else happened.

slides.title: Democrats win both houses
slides.image_prompt: The US Capitol dome at sunrise, a wooden ballot box on the steps in front, clear sky, calm morning light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Democrats won control of the House and the Senate.
WHY IT MATTERS
Congress can now block Trump's bills and investigate.
FOR YOU
From next year, new federal laws will need Democratic support to pass.
slides.body: Democrats won control of the House and the Senate. Congress can now block Trump's bills and investigate. From next year, new federal laws will need Democratic support to pass.

slides.title: Hormuz: tankers on fire
slides.image_prompt: A large oil tanker at sea at dusk with smoke rising from its deck, a small tugboat nearby, calm water, distant coastline
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran says 2 tankers and a tugboat caught fire in Hormuz.
WHY IT MATTERS
Trump says the war was worth it despite election losses.
FOR YOU
Oil prices fell this week, but Gulf shipping risks keep fuel costs uncertain.
slides.body: Iran says 2 tankers and a tugboat caught fire in Hormuz. Trump says the war was worth it despite election losses. Oil prices fell this week, but Gulf shipping risks keep fuel costs uncertain.

slides.title: Dow jumps, chip stocks sink
slides.image_prompt: A shiny silicon chip wafer on a dark table beside a stack of coins and a red downward arrow made of copper wire
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Dow rose 1,569 points; Korea's KOSPI fell 5.3% Thursday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Investors fear tighter AI data-centre rules under Democrats.
FOR YOU
Got tech or chip funds? Check them: AI stocks swung hard this week.

slides.title: Europe flights hit by threats
slides.image_prompt: A passenger jet landing on a wet runway at dawn, a military jet flying alongside in the grey sky, airport lights glowing
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Airlines in Europe got bomb threats again Thursday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Flights diverted, some escorted by jets; none proved real.
FOR YOU
Flying in Europe? Check your flight status; delays and diversions are possible.
slides.body: Airlines in Europe got bomb threats again Thursday. Flights diverted, some escorted by jets; none proved real. Flying in Europe? Check your flight status; delays and diversions are possible.

slides.title: A Senate first in Michigan
slides.image_prompt: An old wooden Senate desk in a grand marble chamber, warm light falling on an empty chair, a small brass nameplate without text
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's Senate seat on Tuesday.
WHY IT MATTERS
He'll be the first Muslim elected to the US Senate.
FOR YOU
A small piece of history: no Muslim had been elected senator before.
slides.body: Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's Senate seat on Tuesday. He'll be the first Muslim elected to the US Senate. A small piece of history: no Muslim had been elected senator before.
